intermediate_main_refresh.note: The first normal refresh introduced tls13-traffic-key-material. A final fetch found main had advanced again; the second normal merge preserves that history and adds no BUILD root or implementation identity.

classification.notes: Rust-only fixed-memory derivation of cipher-suite-bound TLS 1.3 traffic keys and static IVs from a caller-supplied traffic secret. It extends the existing TLS record-prerequisite classifier and still requires explicit neutral decomposition plus SHA-384, HMAC, HKDF, suite-policy, zeroization, and AEAD prerequisite review. It does not claim TLS, HTTPS, handshake, credential custody, constant-time assurance, network, trust, certificate, or deployment authority.

priority.reason: The new blocked TLS classification owner has no newly unlocked delivery child and does not overlap the selected twelve-lane SHA-512 paths. The in-progress SHA-512 owner remains dependency-ready and continues to gate its two direct and eighteen total unfinished descendants.
